title: Tilted dark site: hero, chat, metrics
summary: A dark violet landing page leaned back in 3D, cut twice: hero headline under a slow push, an assistant chat panel panning left, then the chat beside four metric tiles drifting right. Three planes, no type animation, all motion is camera.
use_when: A service or agency site with a hero, an assistant and a results block
Short silent teaser where the UI itself is the whole story
Dark brand with a single violet or blue accent
B-roll under VO or a social post, 10 s, no copy beyond the UI

look.type_style: hero: bold geometric grotesk, title case, two lines, ~6 % H, light grey on violet; UI text small sans; metric figures mid-weight grotesk

sfx.event: hard cut to the chat panel
hard cut to the metrics plane

structure.shot: landing hero on a tilted plane: nav bar, small pill badge, two-line headline, two-line sub, two buttons; violet glow top right
structure.camera: tilt-plane leaned back ~15 deg, right edge farther; push-in ~1.2 %/s (1.00 -> 1.04 over 93 fr), no pan
structure.motion: nothing inside the page moves; camera only, easings.linear over 93 fr; edges soft from depth of field

structure.shot: assistant chat panel on the same site: window chrome dots, assistant header, greeting, user request bubble, assistant reply, quick-reply chip
structure.camera: tilt-plane, rotated ~8 deg in Z and leaned back; dolly: content travels left ~72 px/s @1920 (2.4 px/fr), push ~0.5-1 %/s
structure.motion: camera only: easings.linear dolly over 110 fr; bubbles already present (no entrances visible at 0.25 s)

structure.shot: wider plane: chat column on the left, 2x2 grid of dark metric tiles (time, count, count, large count) with accent underlines
structure.camera: tilt-plane flatter and closer, rotated ~-10 deg in Z; dolly: content travels right ~100 px/s @1920 slowing to ~77 px/s, push-in ~2.3 %/s, roll -0.6 deg/s
structure.motion: camera only: easings.linear dolly over 119 fr with a slight slow-down after 9.0 s; figures static (no count-up visible at 0.25 s); ends mid-move

params.brand: dark brand.json: bg near black, violet accent, display font for the hero
params.content.hero: two-line headline, 2 words per line, plus a 2-line sub and two button labels
params.content.badge: small pill above the headline, 3-4 words
params.content.chat: 3-4 messages: assistant greeting, user request, assistant reply, quick-reply chip
params.content.metrics: 4 figures with short labels (a time, two counts, one large count)
params.camera.tilt: rotateX / rotateZ per plane; keep every plane leaned, never flat-on

notes: Cuts at 3.10 s (f93) and 6.77 s (f203) measured on 30 fps strips; cuts.json missed both (dark, low contrast; near misses 3.10 and 6.767). Motion per second from motion.json: shot 1 zoom 1.1-1.4 %/s, shot 2 pan -71..-76 px/s, shot 3 pan +77..+102 px/s, zoom 2.0-2.5 %/s. All motion is camera; the UI is a still rebuild. The direction flips at every cut (still -> left -> right). sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent). Proposed term: direction-flip cut (not in vocabulary).
